name: Voynich Pisces Structural Benchmark
description: This paper presents a rigorously defined, semantics-neutral structural benchmark for the Voynich Manuscript, focused on the 30 nymph and star labels of the Pisces zodiac folio f70v2. Using hierarchical agglomerative clustering with Levenshtein edit distance and average linkage, applied to a fixed EVA-transcribed dataset, the analysis enumerates the full clustering hierarchy at thresholds 1 through 5, identifies tight morphological paradigms and stable outliers, and augments standard clustering with positional dispersion statistics. The otal- paradigm is shown to be over-dispersed across the full label wheel, the -dy/-ody/-oly paradigm to be under-dispersed into a coherent arc, and three labels (chckhhy, salols, ykolaiin) to remain stable structural and spatial outliers at all thresholds. These Pisces results are explicitly contrasted with qo-dominant inner-ring zodiac subsystems, which exhibit radically different clustering, entropy, and type-token behavior under identical methodology. The complete pipeline, based on public inputs, standard methods, and explicit outputs, constitutes a falsifiable benchmark that any proposed cipher, shorthand, or linguistic model must reproduce before semantic claims merit consideration. No decipherment is claimed or implied.
